environment.scope: Repository-only / migration-free / additive. Fixes the dashboard 'Daily PnL (realized)' card showing a false +$0.00 on days with real same-day closed trades. Root cause: analytics.portfolio.daily_realized_pnl summed the figure over a WHOLE-SCOPE single denomination, so a mixed USD+non-USD monitored population dropped every non-USD account and a GBP-only trading day summed to 0.0 over the idle USD subset (rendered as +$0.00). Fix: per-account currency conversion summed with the existing portfolio_fx.aggregate_usd (the same per-account aggregator used by the balance/equity totals), with honest coverage states (OK/PARTIAL/UNAVAILABLE/EMPTY) and per-account excluded native detail; the frontend renders PARTIAL (figure + 'Partial - N excluded' disclosure) and UNAVAILABLE ('-') instead of a false $0.00. Automatic for newly monitored accounts (no hard-coded ids, no special-case packets). No production deploy, no migration, no host/MT5 mutation, no manual snapshot, no broker action, no Copy-Trading change.

ci.lane: backend (manage.py test) + frontend (vitest + eslint + next build) + governance (secret/PII scan + evidence lint). Pure Python + TypeScript change; no PowerShell artefact; no migration.

expected_results: Daily realized P&L includes EVERY monitored account's same-day realized: a non-USD account is converted per-account via the vetted rate and summed (no longer dropped by a whole-scope single-currency rule); a mixed USD+GBP day with an available rate is COMPLETE, not PARTIAL-dropping-GBP.

Never a false zero: same-day activity that cannot be converted is EXCLUDED and surfaced with its native amount (PARTIAL), or the figure is UNAVAILABLE (null, never 0.0) when no activity converts; a genuine no-trade day is EMPTY (0.0); an exactly-zero complete day shows 0.0 truthfully.
profit+commission+swap counted exactly once; deposits/withdrawals (balance deals, no position_id) never contribute; day window is the broker-server close_time calendar date; yesterday excluded.

Automatic enrolment: a newly monitored account enters the figure with no hard-coded id / special-case packet; one bounded trade query for the whole scope (no N+1); tenant-isolated (owner scope only, no cross-account substitution).
Frontend: OK -> measured figure; PARTIAL -> figure + 'Partial - N excluded' disclosure naming each excluded native amount; UNAVAILABLE -> '-' (never +$0.00).
Back-compatible: daily_realized_pnl still returns (value, basis); existing analytics tests pass; migration-free; secret scan + evidence lint clean; no Copy-Trading / broker / is_active / host change.
